role: 炎の羽飾り (head). Flame-like orange and red feathers on a small holder, standing on the dome and trailing back (left). While it is worn the hero's red helmet plume is erased from the animation sheets (src/core/heroPlume.ts); the still and the face icon keep it.

source.description: pixel art game item: a small helmet plume made of flame-like feathers, bright orange and yellow fire feathers curling back to the left, attached at the bottom, side view, dark outline

note: Trimmed (16x17) and mirrored left-right (the generated plume curled to the right). Alpha is 0/255 only; 57 colors. The pivot is the holder's foot 2 px right of its middle, so it stands where the original plume grows. Laid over the original plume it looked doubled, so the user asked to take the original off.
